analysis_rules.clean_role: Input-only leakage diagnostic. Its exact 0.50 accuracy is arithmetic under the balanced design, not evidence.
analysis_rules.direction_controls: Report target, random, and coordinate-shuffled directions separately. Success on random or shuffled directions means generic hidden-state codebook learning, not semantic specificity.
analysis_rules.inference_unit: Concept-derived direction and carrier family, resampled independently. Enumerate the finite crossed-bootstrap count distribution exactly; the 24 episode cells are nuisance marginalization.
analysis_rules.no_retuning: Do not change model, layer, strength, labels, controls, gates, or analysis after inspecting confirm results. Correct only validation defects that invalidate the run, disclose them, and start a new artifact.

development_basis: Model, layer, strength, shot count, and labels were selected with the ocean direction centered against all eight DEV_CONCEPTS and one neutral carrier. The development target scored 22/24 and is not confirmatory evidence.
previous_run_disclosure: The first held-out artifact was inspected before this protocol. Audit found a 1.4%-3.9% target/query-only query-scale mismatch, jointly centered test directions, incomplete transitive source hashing, and Monte Carlo intervals. This v2 keeps every tuned setting fixed, corrects those design/provenance issues, and uses entirely fresh concept-derived directions and more varied carrier text.
